map.输入输入扭矩 τ_in、减速比 GR、效率 η，求输出扭矩。: Enter the input torque τ_in, the reduction ratio GR and the efficiency η to get the output torque.
map.📖 查看「由输入扭矩与减速比求输出扭矩 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the output torque from the input torque and reduction ratio"
map.📚 深度解析：齿轮传动输出扭矩: 📚 Deep Dive: Gear drive output torque
map.T_out=1×10×0.9=9 N·m；减速 10 倍增扭并计 10% 损耗。: T_out = 1 x 10 x 0.9 = 9 N·m; a 10x reduction multiplies the torque and charges 10% loss.
map.T_out=10 N·m，理想无损耗。: T_out = 10 N·m, the ideal lossless case.
map.减速换扭矩，T_out=T_in×i×η。: Reduction trades speed for torque, with T_out = T_in x i x η.
map.忽略损耗时功率守恒：T_in·ω_in=T_out·ω_out。: Ignoring losses the power is conserved: T_in·ω_in = T_out·ω_out.
